items.exampleEn: I'm in a fix. I lost my keys again.
items.exampleZh: 我遇到麻煩了，我又把鑰匙弄丟了。

淚水從她臉上流了下來。

items.exampleEn: There's no rush. Take your time.
Her new shop succeeded in its first year.

items.exampleEn: The dog escaped from the garden this morning.
items.exampleZh: 那隻狗今天早上從花園逃走了。

items.exampleZh: 半夜我聽到一聲敲擊聲。

items.sentenceEn: There was a knock at the door.

items.audioEn: Sorry, I'm in a rush. Can we talk later?

items.sentenceEn: Here is a useful tip for learning English.
items.sentenceZh: 這裡有一個學英文的實用訣竅。

items.stemEn: When my best friend moved away, there was a ____ in my eye.

items.stemEn: If you work hard, you will ____.

items.passageEn: Last Friday, my family wanted a short escape from the city, so we drove to the seaside. In the morning rush, Dad forgot his phone. Then our car stopped on the road, and we were in a real fix. A kind man came and got it working again. Dad wanted to give him a tip, but he said no. At the beach, Mom poured cold drinks for everyone.
items.passageZh: 上週五，我們全家想暫時逃離城市，就開車去海邊。早上匆忙出門時，爸爸忘了帶手機。後來車子在路上拋錨，我們真是遇上了大麻煩。一位好心的男人過來把車修好了。爸爸想給他小費，但他不收。到了海灘，媽媽倒了冰涼的飲料給大家。

questions.questionZh: 早上匆忙出門時，爸爸忘了什麼？
爸爸想給幫忙的男人什麼？

referenceEn: Thank you for the useful tip.
rubricZh: 「小訣竅」可寫，例如 tip、advice 等
可寫例如 Thanks for the tip.

items.promptZh: 他終於成功找到了一份新工作。
referenceEn: He finally succeeded in finding a new job.
In the end, he succeeded in finding a new job.
rubricZh: 用 succeed in＋動名詞 表示「成功做到…」（例如 succeeded in finding）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 succeeded、has succeeded 等）
「終於」可寫，例如 finally、in the end 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關：fix 在 A2 的常用義是動詞「修理」；本課教名詞片語 in a fix「困境」（口語、屬高級用法），與『詞義以 CEFR-J 該級詞性＋常用義為準』不符；同見 items/13/options/3、items/14/passageEn（in a real fix）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 執行長裁示：教課綱該級列的詞性。fix 名詞 A2、動詞 B1，動詞義「修理」高於 A2 不教，維持名詞「困境」；單元名稱與字詞不符記入 a2-status.md
